name: Garv Arora
title: Software Development Engineer

tagline: I'm a backend engineer and a problem solver. I love digging into interesting problems, from reliable systems to tricky algorithms.
about: Backend engineer building ERP integrations on Java, Spring Boot and Kafka. B.Tech in Computer Science from IIIT Vadodara (CGPA 8.88). I like fault-tolerant systems, clean domain design, and solving hard problems fast: LeetCode max rating 2115, Codeforces Specialist.

points: Built custom ERP data-sync features and onboarded 6 new ERP systems using Java and Spring Boot.
Developed 20+ secure push and pull data pipelines between ERP systems and internal services, including an event-driven real-time sync pipeline on Apache Kafka processing 10K+ records per day.
Made pipelines fault-tolerant with exponential backoff retries and a dead-letter queue, automatically recovering 95% of transient failures and keeping syncs running through downstream outages.
Improved data consistency across integrated systems from 80% to 94% with better tracking of critical payroll data.

JWT with rotating refresh tokens and API-key auth, plus Redis caching and rate limiting.
